sources.title: GitHub - naver-ai/opd2: Official implementation of On-Policy Delta ...
sources.snippet: On-policy distillation is an alternative post-training method that provides token-level supervision from a teacher model. In this work, we introduce the delta signal, defined as the difference between a reasoning-tuned teacher and its base model before reasoning tuning.
